_comment: Photonics / Optics / Laser Werkstudent search, Germany-wide.
Query terms mirror werkstudent_digest_2026-08-08.txt, a one-off scrape the user
already reviewed (Indeed + StepStone + LinkedIn + XING, 41 postings kept after
filtering/dedup). This config reproduces and maintains that search on a schedule
rather than inventing new phrasing.
PORTALS. All 5 installed portals run by default, INCLUDING xing-search and
linkedin-search - the user was told those two are personal-use-only per their
ToS (and that this repo's own CI avoids running them from shared runners for
that exact reason - see .github/workflows/ci.yml's top comment) and explicitly
chose to include them anyway, since they were the highest-yield sources in the
digest (XING: best source that run; LinkedIn: 4 direct-fit postings). This is a
deliberate, informed deviation from the framework's default caution - if the
automated volume needs dialing back later, drop xing-search/linkedin-search
from defaults.portals first, since they carry the most ToS exposure per request.
NO exclude_titles. Werkstudent, Praktikum and Bachelor-/Masterarbeit roles are
TARGETS here (Priority 1 in job-scraper/search-queries.md), not noise.
LOCATION is intentionally unset = nationwide, per the user's explicit choice
during /setup (willing to relocate/commute from their Steinfurt home base).
The digest's postings span Aachen, Berlin, Stuttgart, Munich and elsewhere, so
pinning one city would cut most of them. linkedin-search requires a location
string and freehire-search needs an explicit country - both set once in
defaults.portal_overrides rather than per profile.
Priority 2 (adjacent physics/engineering: metrology, semiconductor, quantum,
precision positioning) is included at lower priority/enabled but should be the
first thing disabled if the primary photonics/optics/laser profiles alone
produce enough volume - see job-scraper/search-queries.md.

profiles._note: English variant - catches English-language postings (Fraunhofer, Zeiss, DLR, etc. often post bilingually).
Priority 2 (adjacent): industrial X-ray/metrology, e.g. Fraunhofer IIS. Disable first if volume from Priority 1 alone is sufficient.
Priority 2 (adjacent): quantum sensing/computing roles at photonics-adjacent institutes.
Broader optoelectronics net - overlaps heavily with Photonik/Laser. Enable if the targeted profiles run dry.
